feature.title: Phone and iPad reader: ask the tutor about a chapter or a paragraph
feature.problem: Reading on the phone has no way to ask anything: a confusing paragraph or a wrong quiz answer means switching to the desktop app. The owner wants an easy Ask-tutor option: one tap from the chapter, about the paragraph you are on, with answers that point back into the course. Design: 'Ask about this paragraph' (iPhone), 'iPad portrait' (sheet) and 'iPad landscape' (docked) on https://claude.ai/artifact/LUdrDTLccSWPURFiLgHjYS, with the sheet fixes the owner asked for (size to content, full-width content, aligned edges).
nonGoals: Saving tutor answers as notes: the reader has no notes, and the tutor is told so (surface: mobile).
Offline asking: the tutor needs the server; offline reading is Phase 4.

surfaces.name: Tutor (sheet below 1024 px, docked pane from 1024 px)

moments.peak: the answer streams in plain words about the exact paragraph you tapped, with [n] links that open the passage it used
moments.end: closing the sheet puts you back on the same paragraph, and the conversation is still there next time you open this chapter

surfaces.purpose: Ask about this chapter, or the paragraph you tapped, without leaving it.

states.loading: While the tutor works: the step it is on ('Searching the course for “margin”…', 'Writing questions…') under your question, then the answer streaming in.
states.empty: No conversation yet for this chapter: one line ('Ask anything about this chapter, or tap a paragraph first') above the quick prompts.
states.error: 'The tutor couldn't answer.' with Try again, which resends the last question; offline: the Ask button reads 'Tutor needs a connection' and the input is disabled.
states.success: Replies render as markdown; [n] markers become small links to the cited chapter, and the sources are listed under the reply. A made quiz plays inline; a made movie or diagram plays inline. The conversation is kept per chapter on this device.

components.control: Bottom sheet that sizes to its content (max 75% of the window, expandable to full)
components.why: the owner rejected a fixed-height sheet with an empty band; the chapter stays visible above a short conversation
components.rejected: a fixed-height sheet, and a separate tutor screen (loses the paragraph you were on)

components.why: an iPad in landscape has room to read and ask side by side, as in the approved design
components.rejected: the sheet at every width (covers half the text on a wide screen)

components.control: Tap a paragraph, then 'Ask about this' chip
components.why: text selection is unreliable on touch; a paragraph is the natural unit and one tap marks it

components.control: Transcript built from the agent's messages (text, tool calls and their results)
components.why: search_course results carry the numbered hits, so each [n] in a reply links to the chapter of the most recent search before it
components.rejected: CopilotKit's chat UI (needs its 2.4 MB bundle and Tailwind CSS, measured in the spike)

components.control: The quiz component, in a local mode for tutor-made questions
components.why: one quiz look everywhere; tutor questions have no server ids, so they are checked on the device

components.control: Tutor code loaded on first open (React.lazy)
components.why: the CopilotKit core adds about 90 KB gzipped; a reader who never asks never downloads it
